# ama4devs

> Local mock servers of the APIs a product depends on, published as Docker images on GHCR, for local development, automated tests and CI without real accounts, credentials or costs. Today: the WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta Graph API v23.0, WhatsApp Business Platform) and the Asaas API v3 (Brazilian payment gateway: Pix, boleto, credit card, installments, subscriptions, webhooks, with a virtual clock). Planned, not built yet: more payment providers and banks (Stripe, Rede/Itaú, Pagar.me, C6 Bank, Banco Inter). Em português: simuladores locais do WhatsApp e do Asaas.

Use it when an application integrates with WhatsApp (sending messages and templates, receiving webhooks, media, voice calls) or with Asaas (charges, Pix, boleto, card, installments, subscriptions, webhooks) and needs a faithful local API to point at. The Asaas mock's virtual clock (`POST /_admin/clock/advance`, needs `CLOCK_MODE=VIRTUAL_FLOWING` or `VIRTUAL_FROZEN`) skips days so overdue charges, D+32 card credit and subscription cycles happen in seconds. A subscription's saved card is charged on each due date with Asaas's retries (08:00, 14:00, 20:00 and three more the next day, a PAYMENT_CREDIT_CARD_CAPTURE_REFUSED webhook each, then OVERDUE); `PUT /_admin/credit-cards/:token {"approvalsLeft": 3}` makes a saved card pay three charges and decline the fourth.

- WhatsApp mock image: `ghcr.io/instituto-ama/whatsapp-mock` (port 3010, API at `/v23.0/...`, panel at `/`)
- Asaas mock image: `ghcr.io/instituto-ama/asaas-mock` (port 45445, API at `/v3`, panel at `/`)
- Both mocks together: `make setup`, or `docker compose --profile asaas --profile whatsapp up -d` in the repository root, with Mailpit for the payer e-mails

## Documentation site

- [Home](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/) (Portuguese under `/pt-br/`)
- WhatsApp mock: [overview and use cases](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/whatsapp/), [quick start](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/whatsapp/quick-start/), [API reference](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/whatsapp/api/), [docs](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/whatsapp/docs/)
- Asaas mock: [overview and use cases](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/asaas/), [quick start](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/asaas/quick-start/), [API reference](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/asaas/api/), [docs](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/asaas/docs/)
- API data: [whatsapp-api.json](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/data/whatsapp-api.json), [asaas-api.json](https://instituto-ama.github.io/ama4devs/data/asaas-api.json) (each operation with whether the mock has real behavior), and their `-details.json` (parameters, body fields, request examples, responses)

## WhatsApp Cloud API mock

- [README](https://github.com/Instituto-AMA/ama4devs/blob/master/mocks/whatsapp/README.md): what it simulates, how to run it, the webhook and its signature
- [Panel and API reference](https://github.com/Instituto-AMA/ama4devs/blob/master/mocks/whatsapp/docs/panel.md): the chat panel, templates, numbers and WABAs, voice calls, voice notes, the X-Mock-* test headers, the /settings routes
- [Templates](https://github.com/Instituto-AMA/ama4devs/blob/master/mocks/whatsapp/docs/templates.md): message templates, seeds, examples of every component
- [Meta's specification](https://github.com/Instituto-AMA/ama4devs/blob/master/mocks/whatsapp/spec/README.md): the vendored OpenAPI of the Cloud API and its errata

## Asaas API mock

- [README](https://github.com/Instituto-AMA/ama4devs/blob/master/mocks/asaas/README.md): what it simulates, the API key, webhooks to localhost, the virtual clock, payer notifications
